sourceContext.originPage: WKND adventure detail page (Bali Surf Camp)

suitableFor: tabbed content switchers with a horizontal tablist
grouping related sections (Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring) where one panel is visible at a time
detail pages that segment long-form content under labeled tabs
notSuitableFor: stacked collapsible Q&A panels where multiple can open (use accordion)
content that should always be fully visible without interaction
grids of distinct items with images (use cards)

notes: New variant derived from the AEM Block Collection 'tabs' block. Standard project naming (plain 'tabs', matching the cards/columns/hero/accordion convention). Tabs was chosen over the existing 'accordion' block: the source uses a horizontal tablist with a single active panel (not stacked expandable rows), and 'accordion' is reserved for FAQ-style Q&A. Content model: first row = block name; each subsequent row = 2 cells [tab label] | [tab panel content]. Decoration builds a role=tablist of buttons and toggles aria-hidden on role=tabpanel divs; the first tab is active by default. Adapted for this stripped @adobe/aem-boilerplate: the vanilla 'moveInstrumentation' import (scripts.js) and its two calls were REMOVED because scripts.js does not export it in this doc project; 'toClassName' IS exported by aem.js and is retained.
